description: Use when an agent must see what an institutional manager (Berkshire, hedge funds, banks) holds and what it bought or sold. Input: cik (or ticker), optional period (quarter end), limit. Output: JSON manager, filing, total value, top holdings with value, shares, put/call and portfolio weight; changes vs the previous 13F-HR: new, added, reduced, exited with share change %. Organisations only. Example: ?cik=1067983&limit=10 Price: $0.004 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

cik.description: SEC CIK of the 13F filer (e.g. 1067983 Berkshire Hathaway); give cik or ticker

period.description: Quarter end (default the latest 13F-HR); unknown period → 404, not charged

ticker.description: Ticker of a listed manager (e.g. BRK-B); give cik or ticker

name: sec_13f_holdings
title: Institutional 13F holdings: a fund manager's top positions, weights and quarter-over-quarter changes
